title: compute_thumbprint(mixed-type dict) raised TypeError; SPEC promises ValueError
replay_message: V009 REPRODUCED: compute_thumbprint(mixed-type dict) raised TypeError (TypeError("'<' not supported between instances of 'int' and 'str'")) — SPEC promises ValueError
fix_hint: Catch TypeError at thumbprint()/canonical_json() and re-raise as ValueError, OR guard against non-str keys before canonical_json.
